text:
Type: white wooden open shelving unit
Use: storing towels, baskets, books and plants, side shelf by a sofa or bed; bathroom, living room, bedroom
Style: traditional, farmhouse, Scandinavian
Materials: white stained solid wood frame, painted shelves, slatted bottom shelf
Colors: white, soft warm white
Shape: compact square tower with a solid overhanging top, four straight square legs, two open shelves and a slatted lower shelf, open sides, light and simple
Feel: fresh, tidy, homely, calm
Goes with: light wood, grey or white tiles, cotton towels, woven baskets; farmhouse, cottage or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: HEMNES
product.description: The open shelves give an easy overview and easy reach.
